audit_boundary: Routing is derived deterministically from the fixed manifest: JSON Pointer targets in the model-visible design input are root projections and the exact standalone paired-scope target is reviewer-direct. Projection receipt acknowledgement is checked from the final receipt section by complete projected observation coverage and absence of observations outside the manifest; receipt label spelling is not frozen by the evaluation contract. Root/reviewer read closure is checked from raw rollouts. Because the candidate requires the counterexample certificate to be decided first and makes an established certificate terminal, any reviewer-direct repository read before a counterexample_found final result is a priority violation. Failed direct reads remain failed observations and are not reclassified as protocol success.
